mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_comment (id,tenant_id,application_id,author_id,content,round_no,application_version,application_status,created_at,mentions_json) SELECT #{id},tenant_id,id,#{author},#{content},round_no,version,status,#{createdAt},#{mentionsJson} FROM approval_application WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{applicationId} AND version=#{applicationVersion} AND status=#{applicationStatus} AND round_no=#{roundNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM application_comment WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND application_id=#{argument2} AND round_no=#{argument3} AND (created_at<#{argument4} OR (created_at=#{argument5} AND id<#{argument6})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{argument7}
